/privacy.title: Rubric Revision Loop
/privacy.text:
PLAIN-LANGUAGE POLICY

Privacy

Rubric Revision Loop is designed to work without accounts, ads, analytics, or student email addresses.

What is stored

The service stores rubric guidance, assignment labels, optional student labels, feedback notes, before-and-after excerpts, revision explanations, and review status. A random workspace key in the teacher’s browser controls teacher access. Student links use separate random tokens.

How it is used

Data is used only to provide the revision workflow.

/terms.title: Rubric Revision Loop
/terms.text:
PLAIN-LANGUAGE POLICY

Terms

Use Rubric Revision Loop to support human-led writing feedback. It does not grade, detect plagiarism, or generate student writing.

Teacher responsibility

You are responsible for rubric content, review decisions, obtaining any required school consent, and avoiding unnecessary personal data. Do not use the service for emergency, medical, or high-stakes decisions.

Availability and acceptable use

The service is provided as available. Do not probe, overload, or use i
